The Studio

Precision behind every soft, undone curl.

Martina Wu is built around a simple belief: colour should look like it grew there. We work in low-lit, unhurried sessions — reading your hair's natural movement before a single foil goes in.

01 — Consult

Every appointment opens with a proper conversation — your hair's history, your week, the look you're chasing — before we touch a single strand.

02 — Colour

Hand-painted balayage and dimensional colour, mixed in small batches and adjusted in real time against your skin tone and light.

03 — Finish

Cuts and styling finished to move — soft waves, defined curls, sleek blowouts — built to hold their shape well past the chair.

Signature Services

A menu shaped around real hair, real days.

Consultations are complimentary and every service is priced after a hands-on assessment — the numbers below are a starting point.

01 Balayage & Dimensional Colour Hand-painted, low-maintenance colour that grows out softly. From ₹4,500
02 Precision Cut & Style Shape and finish tailored to your hair's natural texture. From ₹1,200
03 Curl Definition & Perm Bouncy, long-lasting curl and volume for textured hair. From ₹3,000
04 Gloss & Tone Refresh A fast, glassy top-up between full colour sessions. From ₹1,800
05 Bridal & Occasion Styling Trial plus day-of styling for weddings and events. On request
